Found by the pre-cutover durability audit (2026-08-09, read-only, live dogfood DB queried). The single highest-value finding of the pre-cutover sweep.

## The gap (RUNNING — verified absent this session)
The backup substrate is real and good: scripts/backup.ts, backup-verify.ts, restore.ts, content-free manifest, and a LIVE restore drill in CI (scripts/__tests__/backup-restore-live.test.ts, db-integration job with OPENBRAIN_BACKUP_DRILL=1). What does not exist is any INVOCATION:
- docs/backup-restore.md:149-156: stale-backup alerting is DOCUMENTED-ONLY; launchd/cron wiring "deliberately left to the operator runbook and NOT shipped in this repo."
- `rg -rn -i backup deploy/` → 0. `fd -e plist` → 0 schedulers.
- Documented backups root /Volumes/ThunderBolt/open-brain/backups/ does NOT exist.
- Only real set on disk: /Volumes/ThunderBolt/open-brain-local/backups/core01-20260724/ — created 2026-07-24, manifest head 031. Repo head is 046. 15 migrations of schema drift.
- Stated RPO is 24h (docs/backup-restore.md:17); actual observed RPO is 16 days and unbounded.

## Data-loss scenario
core01 disk fails after cutover. Restore possible only from the 07-24 set. Everything since is gone — live count: 74,904 raw turns, 26,453 thoughts, 11,268 session events, 6,441 candidate memories, 3,480 lanes. Restore WOULD work (verify passes restorable_with_migrations, 031→046 run forward), yielding a functioning Open Brain containing July's memory.

Process crash (vs disk loss) is fully handled and loses nothing — watermark model + Postgres transactions. This blocker is disk-loss / catastrophic only, but that's the case backups exist for.

## Wanted
1. Schedule backup.ts on core01 (launchd plist — the one-command fix; the script is already tested and CI-drilled).
2. Run ONE restore end-to-end before cutover to prove the current-schema path, not just the 07-24 drill.
3. Encode in the schedule that a backup job must NOT overlap a deploy (docs/backup-restore.md:200: mid-migration dumps capture a half-applied schema verify can't detect from outside).
This single action moves the durability surface from blocker to sound.

Truth grammar: backup/restore tooling MERGED + TESTED-in-CI; scheduled backup on core01 PROPOSED; a current restorable backup NOT RUNNING.
